title: Rational-stage normalized constant-unit Frobenius coherence
statement: For finite coefficient field E, the rationalized normalized constant unit commutes with the geometric Frobenius square before passage to the algebraically closed common-stage coefficient category.

source.place: Step 1, finite coefficient stage of the canonical constant input

proof.text: Use the unchanged-integral-object and pure-tensor morphism clauses of rationalDerivedPullback_existsUnique. The normalized rational compositor is heterogeneously equal to the rational localization of the integral compositor. The same holds for its inverse, and equality transports agree after localization by identity preservation. Compose these equalities to identify the rational square component with localization of integralSquarePullbackComponent.

The rationalized normalized unit and constant rational Frobenius structures are the corresponding localized integral maps preceded by their object-equality transports. Apply the pullback morphism formula to those maps and compose the heterogeneous equalities. Apply sfRationalConstructibleLocalization.map to integralUnit_frobenius, use preservation of composition, and remove equality transports to obtain exactly rationalizedUnit_frobenius.

proof_origin.place: Step 1, finite coefficient stage of the canonical constant input; rational localization of the integral normalized-unit square

theorem rationalizedUnit_frobenius
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (X₀ Y₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀)))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Y₀.hom]
    (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) :
    letI := fun x ↦ sfWeilPrimeInvertible D l hl X₀ x
    letI := fun y ↦ sfWeilPrimeInvertible D l hl Y₀ y
    let f := FrobeniusExchange.fiberMap D f₀
    let K := constantWeilRationalObject l E D hl (D.geometricFiber Y₀).left
    let u := rationalizedUnit D l hl E f
    (podRationalSquarePullbackComponent l E f
        (D.geometricFrobenius X₀).hom (D.geometricFrobenius Y₀).hom
        (zlFrobenius_naturality D f₀) K).hom ≫
        (rationalDerivedPullback l E f).map
          (constantWeilRationalComplex l E D hl Y₀).str.hom ≫ u.hom =
      (sfWeilFrobeniusPullback D l hl X₀ E).map u.hom ≫
        (constantWeilRationalComplex l E D hl X₀).str.hom
